summary: Practise FIDIC notices, variations, payment reviews and claims records. Explore the five-day foundation course and its applied exercises.
lede: FIDIC contract management is the day-to-day administration of duties, time, payments, changes and claims under a FIDIC form. For construction contract administrators, quantity surveyors and project engineers, it covers interpreting provisions, tracking notice timelines, assessing variations and reviewing payment records. Participants also practise building claim chronologies and preparing decision briefs and traceable project records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review, issue, assess or record actions under FIDIC construction contracts and need a reliable foundation in day-to-day administration.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: No prior FIDIC training is required. Basic familiarity with construction project roles and contract documents will help you follow the exercises. Coding or programming is not required. Advanced topics, including claims and dispute-board procedures, are introduced at foundation level rather than taught as legal or technical implementation work.
